<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, $filter, $location, spUtil, $window) {
    var c = this;

    // List state
    c.searchSwap = '';
    c.listFilter = 'pending';
    c.currentPage = 1;
    c.itemsPerPage = 10;

    // Bulk / Modal state
    c.selectAll = false;
    c.showRejectModal = false;
    c.isBulkReject = false;
    c.rejectReason = '';
    c.pendingRejectIds = [];
    c.isActing = false;

    // Detail view state
    c.selectedItem = null;
    c.detailData = null;
    c.isLoadingDetails = false;
    c.data.isUploadingAttachment = false;

    // OOB Widgets Tracking
    c.data.ticketWidget = null;
    c.data.attachmentWidget = null; 
    c.data.isLoadingWidget = false;

    c.pendingCount = 0;
    c.historyCount = 0;

    // ---- FORMATTING ----
    c.formatINR = function(val) {
        if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return '0.00';
        var num = parseFloat(val);
        if (isNaN(num)) return '0.00';
        return num.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
    };

    // ---- URL DEEP LINKING INITIALIZATION ----
    var initUrlNumber = $location.search().number;
    if (initUrlNumber) {
        c.server.update().then(function() {
            var targetSwap = c.data.list.find(function(s) { return s.number === initUrlNumber; });
            if (targetSwap) {
                c.viewDetails(targetSwap);
            }
        });
    }

    // ---- LIST HELPERS & COUNTS ----
    c.updateCounts = function() {
        if(!c.data.list) return;
        c.pendingCount = c.data.list.filter(function(i) { return i.myApprovalState === 'requested'; }).length;
        c.historyCount = c.data.list.filter(function(i) { return i.myApprovalState !== 'requested'; }).length;
    };

    c.setFilter = function(filterType) { 
        c.listFilter = filterType; 
        c.currentPage = 1;
        c.selectAll = false;
        c.toggleSelectAll(); // uncheck all
    };

    c.getFilteredList = function() {
        var arr = c.data.list || [];
        if (c.listFilter === 'pending') {
            arr = arr.filter(function(b) { return b.myApprovalState === 'requested'; });
        } else if (c.listFilter === 'history') {
            arr = arr.filter(function(b) { return b.myApprovalState !== 'requested'; });
        }
        return $filter('filter')(arr, c.searchSwap);
    };

    c.getPaginatedList = function() {
        var filtered = c.getFilteredList();
        var start = (c.currentPage - 1) * c.itemsPerPage;
        return filtered.slice(start, start + c.itemsPerPage);
    };

    c.totalPages = function() {
        return Math.ceil(c.getFilteredList().length / c.itemsPerPage) || 1;
    };

    c.getMathMin = function(a, b) { return Math.min(a, b); };

    c.changePage = function(delta) {
        c.currentPage += delta;
        c.selectAll = false;
        c.checkSelection();
    };

    // ---- BULK SELECTION ----
    c.toggleSelectAll = function() {
        var list = c.getPaginatedList();
        var allSelected = c.selectAll;
        list.forEach(function(item) {
            item.selected = allSelected;
        });
    };

    c.checkSelection = function() {
        var list = c.getPaginatedList();
        if (list.length === 0) {
            c.selectAll = false;
            return;
        }
        c.selectAll = list.every(function(item) { return item.selected; });
    };

    c.getSelectedItems = function() {
        if (!c.data.list) return [];
        return c.data.list.filter(function(item) { return item.selected && item.myApprovalState === 'requested'; });
    };

    // ---- VIEW DETAILS ----
    c.viewDetails = function(item) {
        c.selectedItem = item;
        c.isLoadingDetails = true;
        c.detailData = null;
        c.data.ticketWidget = null;
        c.data.attachmentWidget = null;
        
        // Deep linking updates
        $location.search('number', item.number);

        c.server.get({
            action: 'get_swap_details',
            swapSysId: item.swap_sys_id
        }).then(function(response) {
            // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Applying mapped detailed logic back to front-end
            c.detailData = {
                approvals:  response.data.approvalData   || [],
                extended:   response.data.extendedDetails || { donee: {}, donor: {} }
            };
            c.isLoadingDetails = false;
            c.data.isLoadingWidget = true;

            // 1. Inject Native OOB Ticket Attachments Widget
            spUtil.get('ticket-attachments', {
                sys_id: item.swap_sys_id,
                table: 'x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request'
            }).then(function(attWidget) {
                c.data.attachmentWidget = attWidget;

                // 2. Inject Native OOB Ticket Conversation Widget
                spUtil.get('widget-ticket-conversation', {
                    sys_id: item.swap_sys_id,
                    table: 'x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request', 
                    btnLabel: 'Post Reply'
                }).then(function(convoWidget) {
                    c.data.ticketWidget = convoWidget;
                    c.data.isLoadingWidget = false;
                });
            });
        });
    };

    // HIGHLIGHT: ACTION - Native File Attachments specific to Record Activity Stream
    c.attachFileToStream = function(inputElement) {
        if (!inputElement.files || inputElement.files.length === 0) return;
        var file = inputElement.files[0];
        
        c.data.isUploadingAttachment = true;
        $scope.$applyAsync(); // Force Angular Digest for UI Spinner Loader

        var reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
            var base64Data = e.target.result.split(',')[1];
            
            c.server.get({
                action: 'upload_attachment',
                swapSysId: c.selectedItem.swap_sys_id,
                fileName: file.name,
                contentType: file.type,
                fileData: base64Data
            }).then(function(response) {
                c.data.isUploadingAttachment = false;
                if (response.data.success) {
                    spUtil.addInfoMessage("File '"+ file.name +"' securely attached to the request.");
                    // Re-trigger the Drilldown to natively refresh both Conversation and Attachment widgets
                    c.viewDetails(c.selectedItem); 
                } else {
                    spUtil.addErrorMessage("System Error: Unable to upload attachment securely.");
                }
            });
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };

    c.goBack = function() {
        c.selectedItem = null;
        c.detailData = null;
        c.data.ticketWidget = null;
        c.data.attachmentWidget = null;
        c.isLoadingDetails = false;
        $location.search('number', null);
    };

    // ---- ACTION: APPROVE ----
    c.approve = function(item) {
        c.isActing = true;
        c.server.get({
            action: 'approve_reject',
            approvalSysIds: [item.approval_sys_id],
            newState: 'approved'
        }).then(function(response) {
            c.data.list = response.data.list;
            c.updateCounts();
            c.isActing = false;
        });
    };

    c.approveFromDetail = function(item) {
        c.isActing = true;
        c.server.get({
            action: 'approve_reject',
            approvalSysIds: [item.approval_sys_id],
            newState: 'approved'
        }).then(function(response) {
            c.data.list = response.data.list;
            c.updateCounts();
            c.isActing = false;
            c.selectedItem = null;
            c.detailData = null;
            $location.search('number', null);
        });
    };

    c.bulkApprove = function() {
        var selectedIds = c.getSelectedItems().map(function(i) { return i.approval_sys_id; });
        if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;

        c.isActing = true;
        c.server.get({
            action: 'approve_reject',
            approvalSysIds: selectedIds,
            newState: 'approved'
        }).then(function(response) {
            c.data.list = response.data.list;
            c.updateCounts();
            c.selectAll = false;
            c.isActing = false;
        });
    };

    // ---- ACTION: REJECT MODAL ----
    c.openRejectModal = function(item, isBulk) {
        c.isBulkReject = isBulk;
        c.rejectReason = '';
        if (isBulk) {
            c.pendingRejectIds = c.getSelectedItems().map(function(i) { return i.approval_sys_id; });
        } else {
            c.pendingRejectIds = [item.approval_sys_id];
        }
        c.showRejectModal = true;
    };

    c.cancelReject = function() {
        c.showRejectModal = false;
        c.pendingRejectIds = [];
        c.rejectReason = '';
    };

    c.confirmReject = function() {
        if (c.pendingRejectIds.length === 0) return;
        c.isActing = true;
        c.showRejectModal = false;

        var wasInDetail = (c.selectedItem && c.pendingRejectIds.indexOf(c.selectedItem.approval_sys_id) > -1);

        c.server.get({
            action: 'approve_reject',
            approvalSysIds: c.pendingRejectIds,
            newState: 'rejected',
            rejectReason: c.rejectReason
        }).then(function(response) {
            c.data.list = response.data.list;
            c.updateCounts();
            c.pendingRejectIds = [];
            c.rejectReason = '';
            c.selectAll = false;
            c.isActing = false;
            
            if (wasInDetail) {
                c.selectedItem = null;
                c.detailData = null;
                $location.search('number', null);
            }
        });
    };

    // Run on Load
    if(c.data.list) {
        c.updateCounts();
    }
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* Premium Enterprise Container Styling */

    // Global Segment Mapping Enforcer
    var segmentMapping = { 'UTCL': 'Cement', 'URMX': 'RMC', 'GIL': 'BPD' };

    function getInternalState(stateStr) {
        var s = (stateStr || '').toLowerCase();
        if (s.indexOf('pending') > -1 || s.indexOf('requested') > -1) return 'pending';
        if (s.indexOf('approved') > -1 || s.indexOf('complete') > -1 || s.indexOf('3') > -1) return 'approved';
        if (s.indexOf('reject') > -1 || s.indexOf('cancel') > -1 || s.indexOf('4') > -1) return 'rejected';
        return 'work';
    }

    // HIGHLIGHT: GET VALUE - Geography Name(Code) display mapping specifically for GlideRecords inside loops
    function getFormattedGeo(gr, nameField, codeField) {
        var name = gr.getValue(nameField) || '';
        var code = gr.getValue(codeField) || '';
        if (name && code) return name + ' (' + code + ')';
        if (name) return name;
        if (code) return code;
        return 'N/A';
    }

    // HIGHLIGHT: GET VALUE - Geography Name(Code) fallback explicitly dot-walking Reference Fields natively
    function formatRefGeo(grRecord, nameField, codeField) {
        var name = grRecord.getElement(nameField).toString() || '';
        var code = grRecord.getElement(codeField).toString() || '';
        if (name && code) return name + ' (' + code + ')';
        if (name) return name;
        if (code) return code;
        return 'N/A';
    }

    // HIGHLIGHT: GET VALUE - Safety hook function to pull the real-time Live Outstanding specifically for master-grid view
    function getLiveOutstanding(customerCode) {
        if(!customerCode) return 0;
        var outRec = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer_outstanding');
        outRec.addQuery('customer', customerCode);
        outRec.orderByDesc('created_on');
        outRec.setLimit(1);
        outRec.query();
        if (outRec.next()) {
            return parseFloat(outRec.getValue('outstanding') || 0);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    var userId = gs.getUserID();

    // ========== ACTION 1: GET SWAP DETAILS & BUCKET AGING ==========
    if (input && input.action == 'get_swap_details') {
        var swapSysId = input.swapSysId;

        // Approvals & Role extraction via document_id mapping to Task
        data.approvalData = [];
        var allAppGr = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
        var qc = allAppGr.addQuery('sysapproval', swapSysId);
        qc.addOrCondition('document_id', swapSysId); 
        allAppGr.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        allAppGr.query();
        
        while (allAppGr.next()) {
            
            // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Pulling role specifically from the newly requested "approval_journal_column"
            var customRole = allAppGr.getValue('approval_journal_column') || allAppGr.getValue('u_role') || allAppGr.getValue('u_approval_level') || 'Approver';
            if (customRole && customRole.length > 25) { customRole = 'Approver'; } // Clean fallback
            
            data.approvalData.push({
                approver: allAppGr.getDisplayValue('approver'),
                state:    allAppGr.getDisplayValue('state'),
                role:     customRole,
                updated:  allAppGr.getValue('sys_updated_on') || '',
                isMe:     allAppGr.getValue('approver') == userId
            });
        }

        // Site profile cards with Exact Bucket-Wise Aging targeting new architecture
        data.extendedDetails = { donee: {}, donor: {} };
        try {
            var swapGr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request');
            if (swapGr.get(swapSysId)) {
                
                function getCustDetails(sysId) {
                    var details = {
                        name: 'N/A', code: 'N/A', zone: 'N/A',
                        region: 'N/A', depot: 'N/A',
                        segment: 'N/A', limit: 0, outstanding: 0,
                        history: []
                    };
                    if (!sysId) return details;
                    
                    var cGr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer');
                    if (cGr.get('customer_code', sysId) || cGr.get(sysId)) {
                        details.name      = cGr.getValue('name') || 'N/A';
                        details.code      = cGr.getValue('customer_code') || 'N/A';
                        
                        // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Formatting Name(Code) directly using the previously formulated custom functions
                        details.zone      = getFormattedGeo(cGr, 'zone_name', 'customer_group');
                        details.region    = getFormattedGeo(cGr, 'region_name', 'cg4'); 
                        details.depot     = getFormattedGeo(cGr, 'depot_name', 'sales_office');
                        
                        var compCode = cGr.getValue('company_code') || '';
                        details.segment = segmentMapping[compCode] || cGr.getDisplayValue('company_code') || 'N/A';
                        
                        details.limit     = parseFloat(cGr.getValue('credit_limit') || 0);

                        // Fetch Bucket-wise outstanding exposure
                        var outRec = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer_outstanding');
                        outRec.addQuery('customer', details.code);
                        outRec.orderByDesc('created_on');
                        outRec.setLimit(6); // Grabbing exactly 6 months of data
                        outRec.query();
                        
                        var isFirst = true;
                        while (outRec.next()) {
                            var outVal = parseFloat(outRec.getValue('outstanding') || 0);
                            if (isFirst) {
                                details.outstanding = outVal; // Set current outstanding to the most recent record
                                isFirst = false;
                            }
                            
                            // Map the detailed bucket history row
                            var rawDate = outRec.getDisplayValue('created_on') || '';
                            details.history.push({
                                date:   rawDate.split(' ')[0], // Extracts YYYY-MM-DD
                                total:  outVal,
                                a0_3:   parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing0_3') || 0),
                                a4_7:   parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing4_7') || 0),
                                a8_21:  parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing8_21') || 0),
                                a22_30: parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing22_30') || 0),
                                a31_45: parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing31_45') || 0),
                                a46_60: parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing46_60') || 0),
                                a61_75: parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing61_75') || 0),
                                a76_90: parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing76_90') || 0),
                                a_gt90: parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing_gt90') || 0)
                            });
                        }
                    }
                    return details;
                }

                var doneeCode = swapGr.donee_site_code.customer_code || swapGr.getValue('donee_site_code');
                var donorCode = swapGr.donor_site_code.customer_code || swapGr.getValue('donor_site_code');

                data.extendedDetails.donee = getCustDetails(doneeCode);
                data.extendedDetails.donor = getCustDetails(donorCode);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            gs.warn('CLM Pending Approvals - extendedDetails error: ' + e.message);
        }

        return;
    }

    // ========== ACTION 2: BULK APPROVE / REJECT ==========
    if (input && input.action == 'approve_reject') {
        var approvalIds = input.approvalSysIds || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < approvalIds.length; i++) {
            var approvalGr = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
            if (approvalGr.get(approvalIds[i])) {
                // Security check: Only update if it is currently pending
                if (approvalGr.state == 'requested') {
                    approvalGr.setValue('state', input.newState);
                    if (input.newState === 'rejected' && input.rejectReason) {
                        approvalGr.setValue('comments', input.rejectReason);
                    }
                    approvalGr.update();
                }
            }
        }
        // Fall through to re-fetch list below
    }

    // HIGHLIGHT: ACTION - Safe native Attachment Upload Handler logic
    if (input && input.action == 'upload_attachment') {
        try {
            var swapGrAttach = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request');
            if (swapGrAttach.get(input.swapSysId)) {
                
                // Natively write Base64 content via sys_attachment 
                var attachSysId = new GlideSysAttachment().writeBase64(
                    swapGrAttach,
                    input.fileName,
                    input.contentType || 'application/octet-stream',
                    input.fileData
                );
                
                if (attachSysId) {
                    // Pushing a note into the comments will natively trigger the OOB Activity Stream refresh 
                    swapGrAttach.comments = "]]>📎<![CDATA[ Secure Attachment Formally Uploaded: " + input.fileName;
                    swapGrAttach.update();
                    data.success = true;
                } else {
                    data.success = false;
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {
            data.success = false;
        }
        return;
    }

    // ========== MAIN LIST (Runs on load + after actions) ==========
    data.list = [];

    var appGr = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
    appGr.addQuery('approver', userId);
    
    // Fetch ALL approvals for this user regarding NT Limit Swaps
    appGr.addQuery('source_table', 'x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request').addOrCondition('sysapproval.sys_class_name', 'x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request');
    appGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    appGr.query();

    while (appGr.next()) {
        
        var swapId = appGr.getValue('document_id') || appGr.getValue('sysapproval'); 
        if (!swapId) continue;

        var swGr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request');
        if (!swGr.get(swapId)) continue;

        var myState = appGr.getValue('state'); // My personal approval status
        var swapStateDisplay =  swGr.getDisplayValue('approval'); // Overall Record Status

        // Customer Code + Name Formatting
        var doneeCodeVal = swGr.donee_site_code.customer_code || swGr.getValue('donee_site_code') || '';
        var doneeName = swGr.donee_site_code.name || swGr.getDisplayValue('donee_site_code') || '';
        var doneeCombined = doneeCodeVal ? (doneeCodeVal + ' — ' + doneeName) : doneeName;

        var donorCodeVal = swGr.donor_site_code.customer_code || swGr.getValue('donor_site_code') || '';
        var donorName = swGr.donor_site_code.name || swGr.getDisplayValue('donor_site_code') || '';
        var donorCombined = donorCodeVal ? (donorCodeVal + ' — ' + donorName) : donorName;

        // Front Grid Geographies directly formatted via Dot-Walking Name(Code) Logic
        var fDoneeZone   = formatRefGeo(swGr, 'donee_site_code.zone_name', 'donee_site_code.customer_group');
        var fDoneeRegion = formatRefGeo(swGr, 'donee_site_code.region_name', 'donee_site_code.cg4');
        var fDoneeDepot  = formatRefGeo(swGr, 'donee_site_code.depot_name', 'donee_site_code.sales_office');

        var fDonorZone   = formatRefGeo(swGr, 'donor_site_code.zone_name', 'donor_site_code.customer_group');
        var fDonorRegion = formatRefGeo(swGr, 'donor_site_code.region_name', 'donor_site_code.cg4');
        var fDonorDepot  = formatRefGeo(swGr, 'donor_site_code.depot_name', 'donor_site_code.sales_office');

        // Fetch Local Outstanding for the Table view Grid explicitly
        var lOutDonee = getLiveOutstanding(doneeCodeVal);
        var lOutDonor = getLiveOutstanding(donorCodeVal);

        // Segment Mapping Fallback
        var rawDoneeSeg = swGr.getValue('donee_segment') || swGr.donee_site_code.company_code || '';
        var mappedDoneeSeg = segmentMapping[rawDoneeSeg] || rawDoneeSeg;

        var rawDonorSeg = swGr.getValue('donor_segment') || swGr.donor_site_code.company_code || '';
        var mappedDonorSeg = segmentMapping[rawDonorSeg] || rawDonorSeg;

        data.list.push({
            approval_sys_id: appGr.getUniqueValue(),
            swap_sys_id:     swapId,
            number:          swGr.getValue('number') || '',
            pan:             swGr.getDisplayValue('donee_site_code.pan') || swGr.getDisplayValue('donor_site_code.pan') || 'N/A',
            
            donee_site:        doneeCombined,
            donee_segment:     mappedDoneeSeg,
            donee_zone:        fDoneeZone,
            donee_region:      fDoneeRegion,
            donee_depot:       fDoneeDepot,
            donee_outstanding: lOutDonee, // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - New Outstanding Prop for Donee
            
            donor_site:        donorCombined,
            donor_segment:     mappedDonorSeg,
            donor_zone:        fDonorZone,
            donor_region:      fDonorRegion,
            donor_depot:       fDonorDepot,
            donor_outstanding: lOutDonor, // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - New Outstanding Prop for Donor
            
            amount:          parseFloat(swGr.getValue('requested_amount') || swGr.getValue('donee_amount') || 0),
            state:           swapStateDisplay,
            internalState:   getInternalState(swapStateDisplay), 
            myApprovalState: myState, 
            created_on:      swGr.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on').split(' ')[0],
            requested_by:    swGr.getDisplayValue('requested_by') || swGr.getDisplayValue('sys_created_by') || '',
            comments:        swGr.getValue('justification') || swGr.getValue('comments') || '',
            selected:        false
        });
    }

})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>sounder.k@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-02 10:09:08</sys_created_on><sys_id>41db74a42b1dcb504572f3745e91bfc7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>42</sys_mod_count><sys_name>UCLM Limit Swap Approval</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CLM" source="x_birl3_clm">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CLM">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_41db74a42b1dcb504572f3745e91bfc7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>gaurav.gorane@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-08 06:28:49</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="abg-widget-container">
